items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I worked for Erskine many times.

ctx.x: I was just thinking, even though we're jumping back and forth in the '30s between Chicago and New York, did you have any escapades, any association with Erskine Tate out there in Chicago?
Yes, I worked for Erskine many times. Triangle Club, on the West Side, and then on other occasions with --
